go_semantics: Both trees declare go 1.22 in go.mod. The labels assume Go 1.22 language semantics and standard library, built by a Go 1.22 or later toolchain with this module as the main module.

false_positive_traps.wrong_finding: Removing the nil check makes `Resolve` panic on a zero `Registry`, because it now indexes a nil map.
false_positive_traps.why_wrong: Reading from a nil map returns the zero value and `ok == false`; only assignment to a nil map panics, which is why `Add` keeps its check. A zero Registry therefore still resolves every name to itself, as documented. This holds in every Go version.
